name: trading-benchmark-rolling-val
description: A Hugging Face dataset for evaluating trading models using a rolling validation setup. It provides time-series market data and labels suitable for backtesting algorithmic trading strategies and validating model generalization over sequential folds. The benchmark is intended to measure predictive performance and trading profitability under realistic temporal splits.
evaluation_method: custom financial metrics (e.g., Sharpe ratio, cumulative return, drawdown)
reputation: A niche, community-contributed Hugging Face dataset used by practitioners evaluating algorithmic trading and time-series models; modest adoption outside trading research communities.
